data.one_liner: Widget that shows an icon based on a file name
data.what_it_does: FileIcon renders an icon representing the file type inferred from the file name. It supports multiple platforms and is null‑safe.
use_when: You need a quick visual indicator of file types in a list
You want a lightweight, cross‑platform solution without custom icon assets
avoid_when: You require highly custom icons or theming beyond the provided set
You need to support dynamic icon sets that change at runtime
strengths: Simple API, no build_runner or code generation
Null‑safe, works on all Flutter platforms
weaknesses: Limited to Seti UI icon set, no custom icons
No support for color or style overrides beyond size
